verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a batch or bulk endpoint, such as bulk send, bulk label, bulk delete, or batch inbox creation, that acts on many items in one operation. Creating thousands of inboxes on demand (agentmail-docs-2) shows scale through repeated individual calls. Listing threads across an organization (agentmail-docs-47) is retrieval, not a bulk action. Both are adjacent capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
